# AVA Technical Safety V7

Scope: Projects 141–200 field-installation and retrofit commissioning failures.

The V7 layer adds generalized protections for cable pulling/handling, conduit/plenum/temperature rules, structural mounting, old-wire shorts/corrosion, passive-network behavior, low-voltage loads, LED voltage drop, enclosure cooling, mains/low-voltage separation, display/window optics and thermal behavior, projector geometry, acoustic treatment dimensions, invisible-speaker finish limits, labeling, grounding/bonding/expansion, firestop/structure, Low-E RF behavior, roller-shade torque, and measurement plausibility.

Production boundaries unchanged: no Education, AVA UI/mobile, customer-data, payment, voice, or hardware-control changes.
